desc:
🏠The siding update is here! Choose between brick, stucco, and more new options to make your house YOURS! + More!

In this realistic construction simulator, build houses from the ground up!  💰 Every step you finish makes your house worth more. Can you become the richest builder in town? 👑

BUILD EVERY PART OF YOUR HOUSE:
🪵 Frame all your walls
⚡ Place a breaker box and wire lights and outlets
🚿 Get water to sinks, showers, and toilets
❄️ Add heat and AC
🏠 Choose your roofing
🧱 Add siding and sheetrock
🎨 Pick your paint colors, inside and out
🛋️ Fill every room with furniture

GROW YOUR EMPIRE:
🔓 Unlock new materials for better builds
🗺️ Expand into new districts
💵 Sell houses, earn cash, build bigger!

👍🌟 Like and favorite Build and Sell Houses for updates! 
Join our community for a reward: https://www.roblox.com/communities/33627792/Zingo-Labs#!/about
